shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on objects, clothing, signs, the suitcase and the house. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep every person, hand and the flag inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.clear_view: The camera has a clear, unobstructed view from a few steps away at eye level: nothing stands between the camera and the people, every face is fully visible and in sharp focus, and both people are seen from head to knees or lower.
shared_prompts.flag: The country's national flag is the only flag in the photo. It is real cloth, correctly proportioned and correctly colored, hanging fully open and flat from a short wooden pole fixed to the house wall beside the front door, at about the height of the people's heads, uncovered by leaves or people. The flag is about 15 percent of the photo width, so it is easy to recognize on a phone.
shared_prompts.family_greeting: The two people stand side by side on the path in front of the open front door, close together, both turned toward the camera and smiling warmly; Ana's arm is around the relative's shoulders. No one else is in the photo.
